series.title: The Quick slider
series.sub: A volume and brightness track that follows your finger

steps.title: Turn on Advanced mode
steps.text: The Quick slider comes with the Dock bar. Open Gesture Volume, switch on Advanced mode and confirm.

steps.title: Meet the Dock
steps.text: Back on your home screen, the round button is now the Dock: a slim tab on the edge.

steps.title: Swipe the tab up or down
steps.text: It grows into the Quick slider, and every bit you swipe moves the level one step.

steps.title: Touch the track to set it
steps.text: Touch anywhere on the open track: the level jumps to your finger and follows it. Let go and it tucks back in.

steps.title: Or press a volume key
steps.text: With Volume keys on Instant, a key opens the slider on the spot and moves it one step per press. Instant needs the accessibility service.

steps.title: Open its settings
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, under Advanced features, tap Quick slider. The preview runs your slider as it is.

steps.title: Pick a fill
steps.text: Open Animation and choose a fill. Shaders and Surge are live effects; the preview at the top runs each one.

steps.title: Celebrate at the top
steps.text: With Celebrate at the top on, a flourish plays when the level reaches 100%. Pick the one you like.

steps.title: Choose what it adjusts
steps.text: Under Content, pick Brightness or one volume. Adaptive follows whatever is playing: a call, an alarm, or media.
